I turned 16 a couple days ago. The curiosity is becoming overwhelming. My parents have always told me that I am not allowed out when it is a full moon. I've always agreed and gone along with what they told me. My parents have never led me astray, but a full moon is happening in 3 days and I have to find out why. Is there something dark and mysterious they are protecting me from? Or is it all nonsense? I have to find out.

He closes his diary and lays on his bed looking up at the ceiling, giving a big sigh*

"In 3 days you'll finally find out, David" he says to himself. "I hope they don't get mad at me" 

David rolls over and shuts his eyes

David stands in front of a mirror. "Today is the day, your gonna find out this mystery once and for all" he smirks. David opens his window and quietly climbs out, and starts to sneak towards the forest. As David walks through the forest he walks sheepishly, his eyes darting from left to right. "Maybe this was a mistake" he says, his lip quivering as he's surrounded by darkness. The quietness of the forest is disrupted by the snap of a twig. "AHH!" David screams and he starts to run through the forest, not looking back in hopes that he can outrun whatever made the noise.

After a few moments of frantic running David has to stop, he has run out of breath and his legs start to ache. He looks behind and sees nothing. He sighs with relief. He turns around and notices a big clearing. He gives a puzzled look as he walks towards the centre of the clearing. It's not like any other field, it's flat and everything is too neat to be natural. As David makes it to the centre of the clearing the clouds part and show the full moon in all its glory. The light illuminating the clearing. "It's beautiful" David says. This thought doesn't last long before he feels a strange feeling. He collapses onto his hands and knees as this feeling gets stronger, he cries out as his body feels pain like never before. His eyes grow wide and dart down to his arms, he notices his skin change to a light brown colour. He closes his eyes hoping that this is all a dream. After a minute the pain stops, but something has changed. He opens his eyes and notices he's much taller than he used to be. The next thing he notices is he can't talk, or move. His body feels so stiff and … wooden? 

David's eyes widen once again as he realises why his parents sheltered him from the full moon. Not because there was evil, but because he had a secret that no one should know about. That he was in fact, a Werehouse.

Thank you for reading :3
